ten: Chi mot chieu (chi Buy hoac chi Sell)
mo_ta: Chi danh mot chieu (thuong chi Buy vang theo y 'vang dai han tang'); xu ly xong chuoi roi moi sang chuoi khac.
vet: Tu 95% lenh tro len cung mot chieu.
ap_cheo: Chi nen thu tren tai san co xu huong dai han ro (vang, chi so); don bay thap hon vi khong co chuoi doi khang.
rui_ro: Xu huong nguoc dai = ket ca chuoi (khong co ve phia doi dien).
bang_chung_ghi_chu: chua co (the moi gieo, chua do)
